title: Chinese-Style Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with tofu, vegetables, and a savory sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fluffy
ingredients.amount: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add mixed vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add tofu and cook for 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, salt, pepper, and sugar. Pour sauce over tofu and vegetables.
Stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes, until sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
